description: Quick Apply for styles: find paragraph, character, object, table and cell styles whose names match a query (optionally prefixed p:, c:, o:, t: or e: to search one kind) and apply the best match to the selection, or only list the matches (Edit > Quick Apply)

apply.description: Apply the best match to the selection (false only lists matches)

clearOverrides.description: Clear overrides while applying (paragraph, object, table and cell styles)

kinds.description: Kinds of style to search (default: all, or the one named by a prefix)

query.description: Words to match in style names, such as "head 2" or "p:body"

name: quick_apply_style
title: Quick Apply Style
